title: USER_FEDERATION: the agent logs a human in through PingOne
lede: The agent on AgentCore Runtime starts a real human login (3LO): pi.flow sign-in, a code to the callback, an exchange, and a token whose sub is the human. Four shapes decide whether it works. Mock only.

edges.label: Bearer token (the human, not the agent)

steps.title: Agent asks for a user token
steps.what: GetResourceOauth2Token needs the workload-identity-directory ARN in the runtime role's policy, or AccessDeniedException ends it before any sign-in.

steps.title: Authorization starts
steps.what: AgentCore Identity sends the human to PingOne with the credential provider's callbackUrl.

steps.title: The human signs in
steps.what: pi.flow renders the form in an iframe: no redirect login fallback.

steps.title: PingOne redirects with a code
steps.what: The redirect_uri must match the PingOne app's registration EXACTLY. The session lookup is keyed on the sessionUri, not the runtime session id.

steps.title: The code is exchanged
steps.what: The vendor authenticates with POST (PingOne's requirement); Basic gets 401 invalid_client.

steps.title: The token reaches the agent
steps.what: The token's sub is the human who signed in: registration per invocation, not once at deploy time.

steps.title: The API sees the human
steps.what: Downstream, the token names the human. The on-behalf-of tab shows what delegation adds.
